tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje phur pa'i dbyangs rol brjed tho bzhugs so// na mo buddha dhwa dza ye/ rdo rje phur pa'i cho ga byed pa'i tshe/ /rol mo gsum brdeg phog pa'i dbyangs rnams ni/ /nam mkha'i lho nub rta mgrin sgo ma dang / /yang dag bde gshegs sgeg cing hūm̐ sgra 'byin/ /dpal gyi ring thung bdag nyid 'dod chags khros/ /lhag ma'i bcom ldan dang po phud rnams so/ /rol mo nyis brdeg phog pa'i dbyangs rnams ni/ /'phags mchog gtso bo yab yum hūm̐ mdzad dang / /dam rdzas skye 'gro de dang gnyis med ma/ /thams cad dbang bsdud dzaḥsprul shwa na ring / /sa bdag ma dang byang chen byang chung ngo / /gsum brdeg nyis brdeg thams cad lan can yin/ /'phags mchog ma la dbyangs byed na/ /sa ma ya satwaṃ zhes pa'i rjes/ /nyis brdeg lan can len pa yin/ /skye med ma la bzhi brdung gsum/ /de rjes drug brdeg de nas ni/ /len chung gcig dang len chen gcig /slar yang de bzhin byas la bzhag /dam tshig chen po'i dbyangs gsar la/ /'then rkang gsum dang dgu brdung gsum/ /de rjes len chung len chen no/ /slar yang de bzhin byas la bzhag /dam tshig chen po'i 'cham dbyangs la/ /'then rkang gsum dang de rjes su/ /gsum brdeg lan can len pa yin/ he ru ka yi gnas bcu la/ /bzhi brdeg gsum dang de rjes su/ /len chung len chen gcig brdeg go /bla med ma la nyis brdeg gcig /de rjes gsum brdeg de rjes su/ /nyis brdeg gcig rnams brdeg pa yin/ /gru gsum mthing chen ma la ni/ /dgu brdeg lan can len pa yin/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rim ma la ni/ /'then rkang gsum dang nyer gcig brdeg /de rjes len chung len chen gcig /slar yang de bzhin brdeg pa 'o/ /shwa na ma yi dbyangs thung la/ /che ba gnyis dang chung ba gsum/ /de 'dra thang gsum byas pa'i mthar/ /che ba gcig ni brdeg pa yin/ /de yi las mkhan ma la ni/ /che zhing dal gnyis che myur gsum/

/slar yang de bzhin byas pa'i rjes/ /che gnyis de rjes len gnyis brdeg /de nas bcu bzhi brdeg gi rjes/ /che ba gsum ni brdeg pa 'o/ /lhag ma'i mgor ni rol mo rnams/ /bcams la bdun brdung gsum gyi rjes/ /che ba gcig ni brdeg pa yin/ /khro bas khro bo'i dbyangs rol la/ /gong bzhin rjes su chems brdung dang / /de nas gsum brdeg lan can no/ /dang po padma 'byung gnas la/ /rol mo bzhi brdung gsum yin no/ /dpal chen 'khor gyi pho nya la/ /bzhi brdung je myur btang rjes su/ /chems brdung byas rjes gsum brdeg ni/ /lan dang bcas pa len pa 'o/ /tshul 'di'ang sngags 'chang chos kyi rje/ /ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi/ /gsung rgyun 'dzin pa'i gsung bzhin du/ /bkod 'dis don gnyer kun dges shog /ces pa 'di yang 'khon rigs shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis bris pa'o// maṅga laṃ// ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ rdo rje phur pa'i dbyangs rol brjed tho/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
